description: Operational SLO targets (issue #71). Intentionally empty: no numeric target is checked in until one is calibrated from measured baseline evidence produced by `cargo run --locked -p aivtuber-app --bin slo-report`, on a representative workload series whose pooled denominators reach the indicator's sample floor — evidence that cannot decide an objective cannot justify a target for it. A target entry must name the artifact and the #58 compatibility series it was calibrated from, and evaluation applies a target only to that series. A zero-tolerance invariant must never appear here. This file is deliberately NOT benchmarks/budgets.json: those are per-pull-request regression budgets, these are absolute operational objectives.
